occurrences.finding: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility: The registered home was observed to not have a working carbon monoxide detector at the time of inspection.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: One electrical outlet in the sleeping area was not covered. This was corrected during inspection.
Children's Products- Posting of CPSC website: The last annual children's product certification was done in 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Posting of CPSC website (26 TAC §747.3935(c))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Lase monthly fire drill documented was in 8/4/23/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records- Photo Identification: There was no copy of photo identification on file for provider.
Policies Comply with Rules: One children's file was missing date of admission, parent information and release information.

Policies Comply with Rules: As of today September 2nd, 2022 the operational policies still do not include promotion of physical activities. The following information is still missing:    (8)Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity that is consistent with Subchapter F of this chapter (relating to Developmental Activities and Activity Plan).     Your policies must include:  (A)The duration of physical activity at your home, both indoor and outdoor    (B)The recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physical activities.    (C) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor time.

AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was observed alone with children during the inspection and the provider has not obtained the eligibility notification from CBCU.    Note: It was discussed that this caregiver must not be present until the results from CBCU have been obtained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications for Substitute Caregiver: Documentation was not available for licensing to review showing how a substitute caregiver meets the minimum qualifications and was left alone with children.    The following information is missing:    Orientation to the Home  Education documentation  Notarized Licensing Affidavit
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications for Substitute Caregiver (26 TAC §747.1209(1))
